title: Clean-Return Mileage Credit for Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Vehicles
content:
**Vehicle return standards — mileage credit for a clean return, Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**Clause.** The clean-return mileage credit is 1000 miles (the high clean-return miles) when no excess wear charge was billed for the turn-in and the lease's final turn-in inspection report records no excess missing key or missing equipment item other than one removed on an inspection dispute; it is 500 miles (the standard clean-return miles) when an excess wear charge of no more than $300 (the clean-return wear limit) was billed for the turn-in; it is nothing in every other case. Where two final turn-in reports share the latest inspection date, the first one recorded is read. The credited miles are added to the mileage allowance before the miles driven are compared with it.

| Excess wear charge billed for the turn-in | Excess missing key or missing equipment on the final report (not removed on dispute) | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | 1000 miles |
| none | one missing key, removed on dispute | 1000 miles |
| none | one missing equipment item, standing | nothing |
| $300.00 | — | 500 miles |
| $145.00 | — | 500 miles |
| $300.01 | — | nothing |
| $620.00 | — | nothing |

**Hypothetical illustration**: a vehicle returned with one excess scratch billed at $145 earns 500 miles; the allowance of 30000 miles is compared with the miles driven as 30500.
